**Finding submitted: compliant — no redline proposed.**

§ 13 (Access Rights and Licence) satisfies all six preferred elements of the LICENSE rule:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Extends to Affiliates | § 13.1, § 13.2 (reinforced by § 30.5) |
| Extends to contractors acting on our behalf | § 13.1, § 13.2 |
| Paid-up licence perpetual | § 13.2 (+ § 14.3, § 10.1) |
| Paid-up licence irrevocable | § 13.2 |
| Subscription revocable only for uncured material breach | § 13.3 (+ § 9.1, § 7.3, § 24.4) |
| Transferable to successors | § 13.3 + § 24.1 |

Two points worth noting in the rationale rather than as deviations, both of which run in our favour: § 13.3 is actually *narrower* than the preferred standard (revocation limited to a material uncured **payment or use** breach, not any material breach), and Affiliate coverage is automatic rather than requiring the written notice contemplated by our fallback. Vendor holds no at-will termination or suspension lever anywhere in the document — § 9.4 without-cause termination is ours alone, § 7.3 compels continued Services during a payment dispute, and § 24.4 blocks suspension or repricing on our change of control.

Per the classification rules, I have not upgraded working language to chase marginal preferred wording, and I made no redline on a clause that already benefits us.
